arxiv-2003-12445.title: Some characterizations of gradient Yamabe solitons
arxiv-2003-12445.creator: Absos Ali Shaikh ∗1 , Prosenjit Mandal 2
arxiv-2003-12445.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Absos Ali Shaikh ∗1 , Prosenjit Mandal 2. In this article we have proved that a gradient Yamabe soliton satisfying some additional conditions must be of constant scalar curvature. Later, we have showed that in a gradient expanding or steady Yamabe soliton with non-negative Ricci curvature if the potential function satisfies some integral condition then it is subharmonic, in particular, for steady case the potential function becomes harmonic.

arxiv-2103-06917.title: Néron models of Jacobians over bases of arbitrary dimension
arxiv-2103-06917.creator: Thibault Poiret
arxiv-2103-06917.description: Abstract Abstract. We work with a smooth relative curve X_{U}/U with nodal reduction over an excellent and locally factorial scheme S . We show that blowing up a nodal model of X_{U} in the ideal sheaf of a section yields a new nodal model and describe how these models relate to each other.

arxiv-2205-11130.title: Manipulation of gravitational quantum states of a bouncing neutron with the GRANIT spectrometer
arxiv-2205-11130.creator: B. Clément, S. Baeßler, V. V. Nesvizhevsky, E. Perry, G. Pignol, J.A. Pioquinto, K. V. Protasov, D. Rebreyend, D. Roulier, L. Shen, A. V. Strelkov, F. Vezzu
arxiv-2205-11130.description: Abstract The bouncing neutron is one of the rare system where gravity can be studied in a quantum framework. To this end it is crucial to be able to select some specific gravitational quantum state (GQS). The GRANIT apparatus is the first physics experiment connected to a superthermal helium UCN source.

arxiv-2210-01151.title: Superconducting properties of doped blue phosphorene: Effects of non-adiabatic approach Journal: \TDM
arxiv-2210-01151.creator: Mohammad Alidoosti, Davoud Nasr Esfahani, Reza Asgari
arxiv-2210-01151.description: Abstract We study the effects of Kohn anomalies on the superconducting properties in electron- and hole-doped cases of monolayer blue phosphorene, considering both adiabatic and non-adiabatic phonon dispersions using first-principles calculations. We show that the topology of the Fermi surface is crucial for the formation of Kohn anomalies of doped blue phosphorene.

arxiv-2303-02164.title: Eryn : A multi-purpose sampler for Bayesian inference Thanks: https://github.com/mikekatz04/Eryn 2023
arxiv-2303-02164.creator: Nikolaos Karnesis, Michael L. Katz, Natalia Korsakova, Jonathan R. Gair, Nikolaos Stergioulas
arxiv-2303-02164.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nikolaos Karnesis, Michael L. Katz, Natalia Korsakova, Jonathan R. Gair, Nikolaos Stergioulas. In recent years, methods for Bayesian inference have been widely used in many different problems in physics where detection and characterization are necessary. Data analysis in gravitational-wave astronomy is a prime example of such a case. Bayesian inference has been very successful because this technique provides a representation of the parameters as a posterior probability distribution, with uncertainties informed by the precision of the experimental measurements.

arxiv-2307-15832.title: Quantum fields in two-dimensional de Sitter space
arxiv-2307-15832.creator: Ben, Dio, Tarek, Gizem
arxiv-2307-15832.description: Abstract We study quantum field theories placed on a two-dimensional de Sitter spacetime (dS 2 ) with an eye on the group-theoretic organisation of single and multi-particle states. We explore the distinguished role of the discrete series unitary irreducible representation (UIR) in the Hilbert space.

arxiv-2309-00072.title: Naturalness-motivated composite Higgs model for generating the top Yukawa coupling
arxiv-2309-00072.creator: Yi Chung
arxiv-2309-00072.description: Abstract The large top Yukawa coupling results in the top quark contributing significantly to the quantum correction of the Higgs mass term. Traditionally, this effect is canceled by the presence of top partners in symmetry-based models. However, the absence of light top partners poses a challenge to the Naturalness of these models.

arxiv-2404-13399.title: A Data-Driven Condition Monitoring Method for Capacitor in Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC)
arxiv-2404-13399.creator: Shuyu Ou ∗, Mahyar Hassanifar †, Martin Votava ‡, Marius Langwasser †, Marco Liserre † ‡
arxiv-2404-13399.description: Abstract The modular multilevel converter (MMC) is a topology that consists of a high number of capacitors, and degradation of capacitors can lead to converter malfunction, limiting the overall system lifetime. Condition monitoring methods can be applied to assess the health status of capacitors and realize predictive maintenance to improve reliability.

arxiv-2410-09337.title: Electromagnetic Coil Optimization for Reduced Lorentz Forces
arxiv-2410-09337.creator: Siena Hurwitz, Matt Landreman, Alan Kaptanoglu
arxiv-2410-09337.description: Abstract The reduction of magnetic forces on electromagnetic coils is an important consideration in the design of high-field devices such as the stellarator or tokamak. Unfortunately, these forces may be too time-consuming to evaluate by conventional finite element modeling within an optimization loop.

arxiv-2410-10623.title: Robust Gradient Descent for Phase Retrieval
arxiv-2410-10623.creator: Alex Buna, Patrick Rebeschini
arxiv-2410-10623.description: Abstract Recent progress in robust statistical learning has mainly tackled convex problems, like mean estimation or linear regression, with non-convex challenges receiving less attention. Phase retrieval exemplifies such a non-convex problem, requiring the recovery of a signal from only the magnitudes of its linear measurements, without phase (sign) information.

britannica-1911-jangipur.title: Jangipur (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-jangipur.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-jangipur.description: Article 'Jangipur' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 15), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. the Mogul emperor Jahangir. During the early years of British rule it was an important centre of the silk trade, and the site of one of the East India Company’s commercial residencies. Jangipur is now best known as the toll station for registering all the traffic on the Bhagirathi. The number of boats registered annually is about 10,000.

pmc-10509724.creator: Seng Chan You, Seung In Seo, Thomas Falconer, Chen Yanover, Talita Duarte-Salles, Sarah Seager, Jose D. Posada, Nigam H. Shah, Phung-Anh Nguyen, Yeesuk Kim, Jason C. Hsu, Mui Van Zandt, Min-Huei Hsu, Hang Lak Lee, Heejoo Ko, Woon Geon Shin, Nicole Pratt, Rae Woong Park, Christin G. Reich, Marc A. Su
pmc-10509724.description: Key PointsQuestionIs use of ranitidine associated with higher risk for incident cancer compared with other histamine-2 (H2) receptor antagonists (H2RAs)?FindingsIn this cohort study including 1 183 999 individuals from 11 large databases across Europe, North America, and Asia, risk of cancer among ranitidine users did not differ from users of other H2RAs.

pmc-10539536.title: Vibration characteristics of an active mounting system for motion control of a plate-like structure in future mobilities
pmc-10539536.creator: Dongwoo Hong, Yang Qiu, Byeongil Kim
pmc-10539536.description: The vibration and noise caused by electric motors in hybrid and electric vehicles (EVs) generate complex signals with a mid-frequency band, which causes uncomfortable vibration and noise. In order to isolate the vibration and noise, active engine mounting systems based on smart structures have attracted attention.

pmc-10546264.title: Diagnostic Value of a Wearable Continuous Electrocardiogram Monitoring Device (AT-Patch) for New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation in High-Risk Patients: Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-10546264.creator: Ju-Seung Kwun, Jang Hoon Lee, Bo Eun Park, Jong Sung Park, Hyeon Jeong Kim, Sun-Hwa Kim, Ki-Hyun Jeon, Hyoung-won Cho, Si-Hyuck Kang, Wonjae Lee, Tae-Jin Youn, In-Ho Chae, Chang-Hwan Yoon, Amaryllis Mavragani, Benjamin Senst, Kam Cheong Wong, Nitesh Ainani
pmc-10546264.description: BackgroundWhile conventional electrocardiogram monitoring devices are useful for detecting atrial fibrillation, they have considerable drawbacks, including a short monitoring duration and invasive device implantation. The use of patch-type devices circumvents these drawbacks and has shown comparable diagnostic capability for the early detection of atrial fibrillation.

pmc-10666616.title: Editorial: Holistic prevention strategies for tail biting in pigs; from farm to slaughterhouse
pmc-10666616.creator: Richard B. D'Eath, Keelin O'Driscoll, Emma Fàbrega
pmc-10666616.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ce tail injury remains widespread. A common thread of the studies included in this Research Topic is finding a way to house and manage pigs to prevent tail biting without tail docking.

pmc-11335283.title: Influenza A virus infection activates caspase-8 to enhance innate antiviral immunity by cleaving CYLD and blocking TAK1 and RIG-I deubiquitination
pmc-11335283.creator: Huidi Yu, Yuling Sun, Jingting Zhang, Wenhui Zhang, Wei Liu, Penggang Liu, Kaituo Liu, Jing Sun, Hailiang Liang, Pinghu Zhang, Xiaoquan Wang, Xiufan Liu, Xiulong Xu
pmc-11335283.description: Caspase-8, an aspartate-specific cysteine protease that primarily functions as an initiator caspase to induce apoptosis, can downregulate innate immunity in part by cleaving RIPK1 and IRF3. However, patients with caspase-8 mutations or deficiency develop immunodeficiency and are prone to viral infections. The molecular mechanism underlying this controversy remains unknown.

pmc-11606909.title: Intermolecular Interactions between Aromatic Amino Acids Investigated by Ultraviolet Photodissociation Spectroscopy of Hydrogen-Bonded Clusters of Histidine and Tryptophan Enantiomers
pmc-11606909.creator: Keitaro Kitahashi, Akimasa Fujihara
pmc-11606909.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Intermolecular interactions between aromatic amino acids were investigated by ultraviolet photodissociation spectroscopy of hydrogen-bonded protonated clusters of histidine (His) and tryptophan (Trp) enantiomers in the gas phase. Product ion spectra and photodissociation spectra in the wavelength range of the S1–S0 transition of Trp at several temperatures (8–100 K) were obtained using a tandem mass spectrometer equipped with an electrospray ionization source and a cold ion trap. l-Trp detachment forming protonated His was the main pathway.

pmc-12459438.title: Comparison of maternal and perinatal outcomes of multifetal pregnancy reduction versus conservative management in triplet pregnancies
pmc-12459438.creator: Hale Cetin Arslan, Kadir Arslan, Tugce Arslanoglu, Alev Atis Aydin
pmc-12459438.description: The increased use of assisted reproductive technologies (ART) has led to an increase in the frequency of multiple pregnancies. Multiple pregnancies are associated with higher maternal and fetal morbidity compared to singleton pregnancies. Multifetal pregnancy reduction (MFPR) can be performed to reduce these risks.

pmc-12595356.title: Safety evaluation of Butyricicoccus faecihominis DSM 34943

pmc-12595356.description: A novel strain of Butyricicoccus faecihominis DSM 34943 was isolated from the feces of a healthy human donor. In order to fully assess the safety of this strain, a full genomic assessment, further in-vitro characterization and a combined in-vivo subchronic 28-day and 90-day toxicity study is reported herein. B.

pmc-12662799.title: Safe haven – a trauma-informed care model for oral health practitioners: a commentary
pmc-12662799.creator: Kristy S. Choi, Woosung Sohn, Delyse Leadbeatter
pmc-12662799.description: There is a high prevalence of traumatic events in our society and the number of trauma sufferers in the general population is significant, with lasting adverse impacts on health, including oral health. Despite the high likelihood of oral health practitioners encountering patients with trauma, trauma history may not be disclosed or evident.

pmc-12784819.title: Effects of Nano-Silver Exposure on Oxidative Stress, Transcriptome, and Intestinal Microbiota of Procambarus clarkii
pmc-12784819.creator: Jian Li, Bin Qiu, Yitian Chen, Yanping Cai, Huiling Zhang, Xingfei Huang, Yude Wang, Shaojun Liu
pmc-12784819.description: Simple SummaryIn this study, we evaluated the histopathological alterations, oxidative stress, transcriptomics, and intestinal microbiota changes in different tissue of red swamp crayfish (Procambarus clarkii) following exposure to nano-silver, which has been demonstrated to be an effective antibacterial agent widely used in water disinfection, including the improvement of water quality in aquaculture pond systems.

pmc-13216599.title: Inhibition of adipocyte RUNX1/2 enhances adipose tissue thermogenesis through distinct mechanisms
pmc-13216599.creator: Cuihua Wang, Na He, Shixiang Wang, Miao Lei, Jie Yao, Li Lin, Xue Ding, Jiaman Lin, Yixin Chen, Qiaoyun Long, Hannah Xiaoyan Hui, Liwei Xie, Yun-Shen Chan, Nan Cao, Shanshan Gu, Wenxiang Hu
pmc-13216599.description: Thermogenic adipocytes hold significant therapeutic promise for combating obesity and metabolic diseases due to their capacity to dissipate energy as heat. However, the transcriptional regulatory mechanisms underlying thermogenic adipocyte activation remain incompletely understood. Here, we identified RUNX1 and RUNX2 as key transcriptional barriers to thermogenic adipocyte differentiation and activation.

pmc-13395827.creator: Krzysztof Łupina, Artur Dziewierz, Jakub Janczura, Zbigniew Siudak
pmc-13395827.description: AimsTo characterize switching among GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) in a large private-sector cohort in Poland and to quantify therapy- and patient-level associations with switching while accounting for switching opportunity and calendar-time dynamics.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective analysis of GLP-1 RA prescription records from the LUX MED network (2018–2025). Switching was defined as any change in agent between consecutive prescriptions.

pmc-13442659.title: Life-Threatening Suspected Intraoperative Bronchospasm During Tracheostomy in a Morbidly Obese Patient: A Case Report
pmc-13442659.creator: Dongyul Lee, Donghee Kang, Ji Wook Kim, Ju Deok Kim
pmc-13442659.description: Suspected severe intraoperative bronchospasm presenting with a silent chest and ventilation failure is a life-threatening emergency. We present a case of a morbidly obese patient (body mass index (BMI) 49.3 kg/m²) who developed suspected severe bronchospasm accompanied by profound hypotension during tracheostomy following prolonged endotracheal intubation and was successfully managed with immediate intervention.

uslaw-usc-t20-s9601.title: 20 U.S.C. § 9601 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t20-s9601.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t20-s9601.description: United States Code, Title 20 (Education); Chapter 76 (Education Research, Statistics, Evaluation, Information, And Dissemination); Subchapter II (Educational Technical Assistance). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this subchapter: (1) In general The terms “local educational agency” and “State educational agency” have the meanings given those terms in section 7801 of this title. (2) Secretary The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Education.
